items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to creating the sewage pollution right to know act

A.actClause: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to creating the sewage pollution right to know act

summary: Enacts the "sewage pollution right to know act"; requires publicly owned treatment works to report discharges of untreated or partially treated sewage.
title: Creates the "sewage pollution right to know act"
